text: My partner tried to visit me on 5th july , from EU.  and they denied her entrance, they left her to sleep in Duty free overnight but promised to give her a hotel room and meals, promised to give her luggage back but they left it in Israel for few days, such an humiliating experience.. its a very random event, they may let your partner enter or may not. better to invite her officialy through Misrad Hapnim
